decisions.decision: The Commission agreed to hold off looking at the Fitchburg rerouting numbers until it meets with Leominster.
decisions.quote: the commission agreed to hold off looking at the numbers until they meet with leominster.

decisions.decision: John asked Wright Pierce (Matt and Kevin) to look at the additional 7% per year in Fitchburg rates in the rerouting analysis.
decisions.quote: john asked matt and kevin to look at the additional 7% per year.

decisions.decision: Paula will correct the redlined 70% factor in Section 18-1 (connection charge) of the Leominster IMA.
decisions.quote: john asked to make a correction to section 18-1 (connection charge), where they redlined a factor of 70% and paula will correct that.

decisions.decision: The Commissioners agreed a bill should be sent to Heather for reimbursement over the billing software problems.
decisions.quote: the commissioners agreed they are upset that it is still not fixed and a bill should be sent to heather for reimbursement.

budget_items.topic: Fitchburg rerouting: 20-year savings vs construction cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Wright Pierce estimated 20-year savings from redirecting flow to Leominster at $2 Million against a $6 Million construction cost, and judged it not cost effective.
budget_items.quote: they estimated the 20 year savings of redirecting the flow would be $2 million vs the construction cost of $6 million, so

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg will increase rates 7% each year for the next five years, which the Commission had not yet built into the rerouting costs.
budget_items.quote: dave noted fitchburg will be increasing rates for the next 5 years and paula confirmed they will increase 7% each year.

budget_items.topic: Leominster rate increase at IMA start
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula said the initial increase under the Leominster arrangement would be substantial, more than 10% to start.
budget_items.quote: paula stated there will be a substantial increase initially -more than 10% to start.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Outstanding bills are losing late fees; 238 bills outstanding were reported as losing $2,300, with a $10 late fee.
budget_items.quote: there are currently 238 bills still outstanding, which is $2,300 they are losing.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A quote from Hall pump for pump-outs at all stations except Meadowwoods came to $7,500 plus disposal.
budget_items.quote: paula finally got a quote from hall pump for $7,500 plus disposal for all but meadowwoods.

budget_items.topic: Capital spending to date vs budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital spending this year was $52,559 against a budget of $95,408.
budget_items.quote: paula reported they have spent $52,559 on capital this year and they budgeted $95,408.

budget_items.topic: Capital spending history and FY24 plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital spending in past years did not exceed $25K; the $95K budgeted for FY24 will be spent.
budget_items.quote: paula noted that in the past years they have not spent more than $25k on capital and they will spend the $95k budgeted for fy24.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Paula is looking at spending up to $120K per year on Capital Expenditures through FY32.
budget_items.quote: however looking forward through fy32, she is looking at spending up to $120k per year on capital expenditures.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Maintenance program was funded at $100K per year but was not all spent; unspent money went into retained earnings.
budget_items.quote: dave pointed out they funded the maintenance program with $100k per year but it was not all spent.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission is asking Leominster for 100 hours of maintenance services each fiscal year free of charge.
budget_items.quote: paula noted they are asking leominster for 100 hours of maintenance services each fiscal year, free of charge, with 30 day advanced notice.

budget_items.topic: Leominster IMA: rate parity with Leominster residents
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave said that if Lunenburg is charged a rate similar to Leominster residents, services should be provided too or a reduced rate given.
budget_items.quote: dave's thought was if lunenburg is going to be charged a rate similar to leominster residents, then services should be provided too or give us a reduced rate.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave said he wished the fee increases could be broken up over two or three years.
budget_items.quote: dave said he wished they could break up the fee increases over 2 or 3 years.
